Create a complete ORIGINAL pixel-game animation sheet. Reference IMAGE 1 is our ORIGINAL identity seed and the only appearance/style authority. IMAGE 2 is a research MOTION/LAYOUT GUIDE only: preserve each slot pose, facing, compression, face visibility, appendage and bubble positions, bound/unbound state, scale and local origin, but replace all commercial character artwork with the identity from IMAGE 1. Do not copy the donor colored pixels or recognizable donor facial design. Mint leaf-eared seed creature: coherent jade/mint green round seed, two leaf-ear surfaces, two separated cream eye caps, dark jade pupils, small peach triangular nose and short separate mouth. Keep the leafy limbless anatomy; feline identity is expressed by facial marks only, never add cat legs, tail or extra ears.

EVERY character in this request is RESTRAINED. A snug GOLDEN ROPE wraps the MAIN BODY, in every pose. The leaves/bubbles are not tied. Include binding in every occupied slot.
Return exactly 4 columns x 3 rows of EQUAL SQUARE CELLS, transparent RGBA background. Each cell corresponds to64x64 native pixels. Copy image2 LOCAL PLACEMENT, RELATIVE NATIVE SIZE, pose geometry and visible expression exactly, but draw the original identity from image1. Body must remain SMALL inside each cell, occupying only the source guide bounds with generous transparent margins. NO GLOW, background, shading outside body, labels, text, grid lines, poster layout, extra images or anti-aliasing. DO NOT center/resize/reorder individual characters. Preserve dramatic flat vs tall vs sideways poses: no generic same front-facing face on every cell. Never add legs. Face openings, closed/compressed expression and occluded face must follow the guide. Do not draw eyes on top of occluding leaves or swept upper-body surfaces.
